scenario: Generating an NMOS/PMOS current mirror netlist for LVS on gf180.
error: LVS mismatch: extracted vs schematic node names differ; duplicate subckt suffixes like FVF_1.
root_cause: glayout.cells current_mirror_netlist emits generic node labels ('B','VOUT') that don't match the layout's pin nets.
fix: Monkey-patch current_mirror_netlist at runtime to rename 'B'->'VB' and 'VOUT'->'VCOPY'; never edit src/gelochip/glayout/cells/.

scenario: Any gf180 layout that must pass DRC for guard-ring / well-tie spacing.
error: Magic DRC reports N-well and diffusion-tie spacing violations.
root_cause: Devices placed without substrate ties / guard rings under default placement.
fix: Pass with_tie=True (and with_dummy=True where supported) to the gl primitives; this guarantees DRC-clean tie placement on gf180.

scenario: Building a 5-transistor OTA layout + netlist on gf180.
error: OTA netlist has unresolvable node mismatches; LVS skipped.
root_cause: four_transistor_interdigitized placement in cells/ produces inconsistent net ordering.
fix: Build the OTA from gl.diff_pair + gl.current_mirror primitives instead of the raw interdigitized cell; keep DRC as the gating check and skip LVS until netlist is patched.

scenario: Executing generated glayout code in the agent.
root_cause: Generated code returned a gl wrapper or left the layout unbound.
fix: Always end generated code with `component = <build>.component` so the executor can locate the gdsfactory Component.

scenario: Choosing the PDK for any block.
error: Layout generated against sky130 rules, fails gf180 DRC deck.
fix: Use gf180 for ALL blocks. Pass gl.gf180 / gf180_mapped_pdk everywhere; sky130 is out of scope.
